system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

data_description.dataset_name: Sentinel-5P OFFL NO2: Offline Nitrogen Dioxide

spatial_coverage.coverage: European land areas and adjacent regions covered by the global Sentinel-5P orbital swath, with valid observations available according to retrieval conditions.

data_description.spatial_resolution: 1113.2 m nominal GEE L3 raster grid (source TROPOMI L2 nadir footprint is approximately 3.5 x 7 km)
data_description.temporal_unit: ImageCollection acquisitions with a nominal 2-day revisit interval; individual orbit observations are not a regular daily record at every pixel
analytical_capabilities: Mapping the spatial distribution and regional gradients of tropospheric and total NO2 column densities
Assessing temporal trends, seasonal variability, and long-term changes
Detecting spatial hotspots, clusters, and geographic anomalies
Comparing NO2 column conditions across regions, time periods, and land-cover contexts
Computing spatial and temporal aggregates, zonal statistics, and relationships with auxiliary geographic datasets
Using the catalog quality-screened L3 raster observations for regional column mapping

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: NO2 column number density in moles per square meter (mol/m²)
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density for lower-atmosphere-focused analyses and NO2_column_number_density for the total column; both are in mol/m² with catalog scale 1. The L3 asset is produced from L2 by harpconvert spatial binning and retains one grid per orbit. Source pixels were filtered at ingestion using tropospheric-band validity >75% (and >50% for other NO2 fields). Apply region/date filters and aggregate valid observations before comparison. Do not discard all negative columns: only treat values below about -0.001 mol/m² as outliers, consistent with the catalog guidance. cloud_fraction is a fraction (0–1) and may be used for an additional cloud screen.

data_description.data_source: European Space Agency Copernicus Sentinel-5P TROPOMI mission
